scope: Input research for detailed Astra implementation prompt only; no website built. This file supplements rather than replaces the root agent’s audit of the user’s exact 21 SEO/UX requirements.
legal_source_note: Authority guidance retrieved in October 2026; the PDF is the 2023 guidance edition and the dark-pattern opinion is dated 2024-12-12. Do not label either a new 2026 law.

sources.finding: E-E-A-T is not a standalone ranking factor or a numeric score. Google warns against changing dates to imply freshness when content has not substantially changed.
prompt_requirements: Build an original O nas page naming the real operator/editor and the site purpose; never invent a team, qualifications or reviews.
Explain source selection, calculations, update policy, corrections/contact and how horoscope material is produced.
Use real publication/update timestamps. A calendar recalculation is not evidence that an editorial horoscope was newly written.
acceptance_checks: No numeric E-E-A-T score or ranking promise appears.
Displayed update time changes only when the underlying relevant content/data changes.

sources.finding: Google recommends concise, descriptive, page-specific title elements and avoids keyword stuffing; displayed search titles can differ.
prompt_requirements: Give every indexable route a distinct Slovene title reflecting actual year/month/sign/content.
Character ranges, if used, are editorial targets rather than Google hard limits.
acceptance_checks: Title examples match the visible route content and contain no stale year.
Home, year, month, lunar and horoscope pages do not share identical titles.
Inspect title/year consistency for every year 2027–2030 and representative first/last month routes, not only 2027.

sources.finding: Google often generates snippets from page text and sometimes uses meta descriptions. There is no fixed meta-description length limit; display truncation varies.
prompt_requirements: Generate readable, unique summaries from actual page-specific data.
Do not promise the submitted description is always displayed.
acceptance_checks: Descriptions summarize the visible function/date/content rather than list keywords.
A reviewable sample covers home, calendar, lunar, horoscope and About pages.
Review year-specific descriptions for all four calendar years 2027–2030.

sources.topic: Images, alt and OG preview metadata
sources.finding: Google can consider og:image or schema image metadata when choosing previews. Alt text supports image understanding and accessibility; keyword stuffing is discouraged. These are not ranking guarantees.
prompt_requirements: Use representative page-specific absolute image URLs, suitable resolution and compressed responsive images.
Use meaningful Slovene alt text for informative images; decorative art should not get keyword-filled descriptions.
Keep key calendar dates as accessible HTML; an image cannot be the sole information source.
OG and social-card tags describe actual content; they do not establish an SEO ranking factor.
acceptance_checks: Image URLs resolve, correct dimensions are set and alt descriptions match content.
Shared horoscope date/sign and calendar year agree with their pages.
Check calendar/PDF/WebP/OG output year agreement for 2027, 2028, 2029 and 2030.

sources.finding: Google does not index 4xx URLs. Returning successful status for an error page can produce a soft 404.
prompt_requirements: Create a branded Slovene not-found page with calendar/home/search links.
Missing routes and impossible resource paths return HTTP 404; do not redirect every miss to home or return status 200.
acceptance_checks: A nonsense URL displays the custom page and actual response status 404.
Valid calendar/horoscope routes return their own successful content.
Missing/out-of-scope routes follow deliberate 404/navigation behavior; year-end links never point to nonexistent 2031 content.

sources.finding: Page experience has multiple aspects; Core Web Vitals are used in ranking systems, but good scores do not guarantee top rankings.
prompt_requirements: Prioritize readable mobile calendars, responsive controls, secure pages and unobstructed main content.
Use measured performance findings; do not claim Lighthouse perfection guarantees visibility.
acceptance_checks: Calendar, print action, zodiac input and consent controls remain usable on small screens and keyboard navigation.
No blocking overlays hide the main task after refusal.

sources.finding: The guidance requires consent before nonexempt tracking and equally easy withdrawal. Its examples flag missing first-layer rejection, prechecked boxes and visually obscured refusal.
prompt_requirements: Block nonessential analytics/ads/embeds until consent for the relevant purpose.
Show comparable Sprejmi vse, Zavrni nenujne and Nastavitve controls; optional categories default off.
Provide a persistent Nastavitve piškotkov link and stop future optional tracking on withdrawal.
Document actual cookies/providers/purposes/retention. Necessary-only configurations do not need invented optional purposes.
acceptance_checks: Fresh-session network/storage inspection confirms no optional tracker before action or after reject.
Accept enables only selected categories; withdrawal prevents later optional requests.

sources.topic: Dark patterns and repeated consent prompts
sources.finding: A 12 December 2024 nonbinding opinion explains valid consent and warns about cookie walls and repeatedly asking users who already declined.
prompt_requirements: Respect and persist refusal; do not reopen a consent prompt on every route.
Allow ordinary calendar and horoscope access without optional consent.
Match labels and consent policy to the real implementation.
acceptance_checks: Reject survives navigation/reload.
Full calendar and calculator use works after rejection.

sources.topic: Dated Slovene daily readings and signs
sources.finding: The provider publishes a genuinely dated daily-horoscope page. This establishes a local content pattern, not search volume or predictive validity.
prompt_requirements: Horoscope is now expressly user-authorized scope. Use original Slovene text for 12 signs, with date, provenance and editorial status.
Select today in Europe/Ljubljana; if no reading is actually published, show the last available date or a truthful unavailable state.
Do not rotate the same text beneath a new daily date.
acceptance_checks: Each displayed current reading has a stored record for that exact local date and sign.
Unpublished future or missing records are not exposed as fabricated live daily content.
Four-year calendar scope must not create fabricated advance horoscope text for 2027–2030; only published date/sign records are presented as available.

sources.finding: The local provider offers a birthdate-based personal-horoscope entry point. This supports tool vocabulary, not a current measured demand estimate.
prompt_requirements: Implement the user-requested sign finder. With month/day lookup, describe conventional approximate sun-sign ranges, especially at boundaries.
Do not label it an exact birth chart or ascendant calculation unless real year/time/place calculations exist.
Process date inputs locally by default; do not put birthdates into analytics or public URLs.
acceptance_checks: All sign boundaries, Capricorn year wrap, leap-day handling and invalid/future date behavior are deliberately tested.
Result sign links to the matching published reading; missing readings remain truthful.

scope_override: Horoscope page, zodiac calculator and dated daily readings are expressly authorized by the latest user instruction. Previous caution about automatically adding horoscope does not exclude this requested work.
limitations: No current monthly search volume, keyword difficulty or traffic figures established for horoscope queries.
Acceptance checks are implementation recommendations derived from the sources and task context, not a claim Google requires every UI detail.
No E-E-A-T score, OG ranking-factor claim, guaranteed ranking or fabricated daily update.
scope_year_update: All four calendar years 2027–2030 are required. Original source dates and historical competitor examples are unchanged. Four-year calendar coverage does not imply daily horoscope readings already exist for future dates or official future school schedules have been released.
